newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices steady, physical demand jumps.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices steady, physical demand jumps.

text.p: The Istanbul gold exchange saw lively trade on Wednesday with a rise in physical demand pushing up volume to 2,715 kg from Tuesday's 1,598 kg as prices remained low, dealers said.
Gold closed unchanged in dollar terms at $344.00 an ounce, but eased slightly in lira terms to 1,527,000 lira per gram versus 1,530,000 on Tuesday.
The Turkish currency firmed to 138,080 versus the dollar against the previous 138,220.
"It was a good day on the exchange. There was intense demand from the free market in the morning, coupled with traders taking up positions in the afternoon," one dealers said.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,490 kg -- took place in the morning session and 54.9 percent of the total was traded in dollar terms.
